rationale: Section 1 of EO 12784 (December 19, 1991) delegated to the Secretary of Energy the functions vested in the President by 10 U.S.C. 7427 and 7428, and section 2 required a report to the President on or before June 30, 1994 and states 'The authority delegated herein expires on October 2, 1994.' After October 2, 1994 the delegation had expired by its own terms, and the reporting deadline had passed on June 30, 1994, thirty-two years before the cutoff. EO 12929 of September 29, 1994 delegated the same functions again without a time limit; that is a separate command, and the only held catalog note on EO 12784 reads 'See: EO 12929, September 29, 1994', which is a cross reference, not a revocation. No source shows a continuing obligation under EO 12784 in 2026. Whether the 1994 report was delivered is not shown by any held source; that affects only the lifecycle first end of the report clause, not whether the order has force in 2026.
